meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动控制浏览器：打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、截图等。
howto.when: 当你需要打开网页、填写表单、截图或提取网页信息时触发。

say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器并导航到百度首页。
Claude 会定位并点击搜索按钮。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, or extract web data.

say_en.note: Claude will launch the browser and go to Baidu's homepage.
Claude will locate and click the search button.
